items.q: What does the trial include and what happens after it ends?
items.a: For 14 days you get access to every feature of the platform, with no credit card required. If no payment method is added after 14 days, the account is automatically paused. We never charge you without your consent. You can add payment later and continue right where you left off. Cancelling a subscription takes one click.

items.q: Do you take a commission on orders?
items.a: No, we don't take a percentage of orders. All orders from the QR menu go directly to the restaurant, with no aggregator fees. You pay a fixed monthly fee — and nothing else.

items.q: Do guests need to install an app, and do we need technical skills?
items.a: Guests don't need an app: they simply point their phone camera at the QR code and the menu opens in the browser. The restaurant doesn't need technical expertise either — the admin panel runs right in the browser on a phone, tablet or laptop. Everything is done with taps and drag-and-drop, no coding.

items.q: How quickly do menu changes take effect — prices, new dishes?
items.a: Instantly. Changes made from your phone appear for guests within seconds. Adding a new dish takes a few taps: name, price, photo. No reprinting paper menus and no designer required.

35 languages are supported with AI-powered automatic translation. One action — and the entire menu is translated. The AI understands culinary context, so dish names and descriptions sound natural in every language. Tourists order with more confidence when they understand what's in a dish.
